crossRefs.note: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
For Yahweh said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud…
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…

translations.web: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
translations.bsb: He loads the clouds with moisture; He scatters His lightning through them.
translations.kjv: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
translations.asv: Yea, he ladeth the thick cloud with moisture; He spreadeth abroad the cloud of his lightning:
